title: Labyrinth Guy
description: That guy, Neon, thinks he’s in a nightmare. but his nightmare is really reality. He doesn’t know reality is really computer-generated. So really his reality is really a nightmare. It’s just a metaphor for the alienation we all feel.
quote: Here, the future is in your hands.
alt2: holding out two hands, each holding a different colored pill
alt3: Neon and a woman on the rooftop
